purpose: Шесть вариантов визуального направления лаунчера для выбора владельцем; концепты, не реализованный интерфейс.

variants.name: cinema
variants.title: Кино
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE exceptionally polished, high fidelity desktop Windows game launcher home screen for the original project DARKWINTER, a northern winter survival game. Landscape 16:10 composition, high resolution. The entire image is the flat front-facing app interface, edge to edge: no computer, laptop, desk, perspective mockup, browser chrome, or surrounding presentation board. This is a design proposal with fictional example data, not an actual game screenshot. Russian interface. Carefully rendered crisp legible typography and coherent spacing. Essential shared functionality in every concept: DARKWINTER brand; small build/version indicator; profile nickname «Путник» with avatar; restrained navigation «Главная», «Сборки», «Настройки»; a RIGHT sidebar with «ДРУЗЬЯ» and three compact friend rows, plus a small «ОБНОВЛЕНИЯ» section; a bottom launch area with selected «Сборка 1.0.0», small status «Готово к запуску», and a large prominent «ИГРАТЬ» button near the bottom. All other copy minimal. Show a recognizable small northern settlement, pine forest, snow and fog in the visual environment, original artwork only. This is a desktop utility with beautiful game art, not a marketing landing page: no enormous inspirational headline, sales slogans, pricing cards, web-like hero buttons, or fictional performance graphs. No real company logos other than DARKWINTER, no fantasy monsters, weapons, tactical skulls, cryptocurrency dashboards, RGB gaming clutter, or cheap generic blue card UI. All UI text, buttons and friend panels must remain highly readable.

ART DIRECTION 1 — CINEMATIC WINTER. A luxurious restrained game launch screen dominated by a stunning film still of an abandoned snowy northern town at blue hour, an old bus stop and distant house windows glowing gently amber, snow crossing the foreground, believable volumetric winter fog. Rich blue-grey photographic tones and warm amber highlights. Extremely elegant white condensed DARKWINTER wordmark top left, airy small navigation across the top. The right sidebar is a subtle dark translucent glass sheet, with small circular muted avatars and fine separators, no heavy card outlines. A dark transparent strip along the entire bottom contains version details left, subtle secondary controls, and a broad warm ivory «ИГРАТЬ» button at bottom right before the friend sidebar. Almost 70% of the image remains atmospheric scenery. Editorial, premium, quiet and cinematic, rooted in 1997 rather than futuristic neon.

ART DIRECTION 3 — NORTHERN RADIO STATION, 1997. Design an original tactile utilitarian launcher inspired by a late-1990s civilian weather/radio station console. Functional compact instrument-like layout, subtle printed markings and monospaced small labels paired with a clear modern sans-serif; thin segmented separators and squared controls, a modest physical-console feeling without kitschy skeuomorphism. Restrained analog personality, not CRT green text, not sci-fi, not a spaceship cockpit.
